hypothesis.equations: scores=QK^T*scale; P=FP32 dense no-mask softmax(scores); O=PV
hypothesis.precision: FP32 dot products, score storage, max/sum reductions, exp, normalization, and PV accumulation; FP16 output
hypothesis.parallelism: one 128-thread block per query sequence position, batch, and head
hypothesis.workspace: dynamic shared memory only; no external workspace or allocation
hypothesis.stream: all work is enqueued on the supplied stream
